_comment: Seed fixture for the workaround-htmx widget-type bead.
Created for ka-0000001237 (free-htmx port — Phase 4 W17). Strategy A —
port-then-soak: lives alongside the Go-coded `workaround` slug rather
than replacing it. Reference ports: activity-log MR !2334
header-incident-summary MR !2347 (ka-0000005304), reproduction-steps
(ka-0000007835), reporter-info (ka-0000004065), event-timeline
(ka-0000000243), ai-recommended-actions (ka-0000000272),
fix-available-pending-branch (ka-0000005506), vm-sparklines
(ka-0000000715), source-code-analysis (ka-0000006619).
Authoring path:
kd create 'Free-htmx widget: workaround-htmx' \
--type=widget-type \
-F gardenio/controller/cmd/beads-viewer/fixtures/workaround-htmx.json
Pre-write hooks (kbeads/internal/server/widget_validation.go) parse
template_source under html/template and reject malformed inputs at
createBead/updateBead time, so a bad fixture surfaces immediately.
Schema validation runs against widget-instance writes per the same
pre-write hook; the schema below is the wire contract.
The wire contract mirrors the Go-coded `workaround` renderer at
widgets_phase4.go::renderWorkaround — a `headline` string plus a
`markdown` body. The htmx template intentionally does NOT render
markdown (the Go path uses goldmark via widgetRenderCtx.md, which has
no template-only equivalent); the `markdown` field is therefore a
parity gap documented in the port doc and in TestWorkaroundParity.
Producers cutting a workaround-htmx widget-instance should pre-render
the body to plain text or accept that markdown formatting falls back
to verbatim escaped output.

fields.template_source:
{{- $headline := index .Payload "headline" -}} {{- $markdown := index .Payload "markdown" -}} {{if $headline}}

{{$headline}}

{{end}} {{if $markdown}}

{{$markdown}}

{{else}}

No workaround documented.

{{end}}

sample_payload.headline: Use the legacy upload path
sample_payload.markdown: Append `?legacy=1` to the upload URL. Logged in users are auto-redirected back.
